gdp_source: R2 model_equation_checks; rounded 2025 GDP in IMF 2026 Article IV p4
model_source: Cangul-Abel SIP/2026/051 Annex pp14-15, same pinned paper and equations as R2
annual_hazard_status: chosen one-year scenarios; not estimated Georgia hazards or a verified annualization of the IMF model
resource_cost_share_status: chosen cost-equivalent sensitivity; not an allocation of actual national costs
drain_status: chosen additional disjoint USD-equivalent calls; not probabilities, observed currency matching, or a forecast
target_status: static translation of the reported target using independent M2/M3 denominators; not replication or an optimality claim
